newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Birch slams Alliance tariffs plan.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Birch slams Alliance tariffs plan.

text.p: New Zealand Finance Minister Bill Birch on Monday slammed a plan by the Alliance to raise import tariffs and said the left-wing grouping would extract a high price for entering a coalition with the Labour Party.
Birch quoted the Manufacturers Federation as saying the Alliance's proposed 10 percent import tariffs would cost that sector NZ$1 billion a year.
"This same misguided tariff policy would put up the costs for all of our exporters -- for farmers and manufacturers and every producer that requires plant from overseas in their production," he said.
The Alliance said in its alternative budget in June that its proposed tariff increase would raise NZ$1 billion in the first year.
Opinion polls show Labour, economic nationalist New Zealand First and the Alliance look set to gain a majority of seats in Saturday's general election.
